item.question_text: An organization building an AI management system is reviewing the table of control objectives and controls in Annex A of ISO/IEC 42001. How does that table relate to the controls the organization ends up applying?

options.text: The table serves as a reference, and the organization can design and apply controls of its own to meet its objectives.
The table is a complete compliance checklist, so every control objective listed in it is adopted by the organization.
The table carries the implementation guidance, while the separate annex of guidance holds the controls that can be selected.
The table is addressed to bodies auditing the system, since ISO/IEC 42001 sets out how certificates are granted.

item.explanation: Clause A.1 states that "Not all the control objectives and controls listed in Table A.1 are required to be used, and the organization can design and implement their own controls (see 6.1.3)." The controls are a reference for addressing risks related to the design and operation of AI systems, not a mandatory list.
item.key_support: Not all the control objectives and controls listed in Table A.1 are required to be used, and the organization can design and implement their own controls (see 6.1.3).

distractor_support.support: Not all the control objectives and controls listed in Table A.1 are required to be used, and the organization can design and implement their own controls (see 6.1.3).
distractor_support.why_wrong: The passage says the listed control objectives and controls do not all have to be used, so treating the table as a mandatory checklist misstates its role.

distractor_support.support: Annex B provides implementation guidance for all the controls listed in Table A.1.
distractor_support.why_wrong: It reverses the two: the table holds the control objectives and controls, and the guidance annex explains how to implement them.

distractor_support.support: This document specifies additional requirements to ISO/IEC 17021-1. The requirements contained in this document, when implemented, support the demonstration of competence, consistency and reliability by the bodies performing auditing and certification of an artificial intelligence management system (AIMS) according to ISO/IEC 42001 for organizations that provide, develop or use AI systems.
distractor_support.why_wrong: Requirements for bodies auditing and certifying an AIMS sit in ISO/IEC 42006, not in the control table of ISO/IEC 42001.
